title: DPDP Rule 3 & 4 Consent Flow Audit

findings: Personal data sent to third-party SDK or external HTTP sink without verified consent guard
Application stores personal data in schema, but no consent withdrawal or user erasure route exists
Personal data table schema missing verifiable consent ledger linkage reference

statutory_recommendation: Ensure consent records are maintained with timestamp, purpose, and version as mandated by DPDP Act Section 6 and DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 3.
